title: Annual Fundraising Gala 2026
description: Join us for an evening of inspiration, music, and generosity. All proceeds go directly to supporting orphaned children with education, healthcare, and shelter.

title: Back-to-School Drive
description: Help us provide school supplies, uniforms, and textbooks to over 500 children heading back to school. Donate or volunteer to make a difference.

title: Volunteer Orientation Day
description: New to volunteering? Join our orientation session to learn about our programs, meet the team, and discover how you can help change lives.

title: World Children's Day Celebration
description: A day of fun, games, and activities for the children at the orphanage. Community members are welcome to join and celebrate with us.

title: Health Screening Outreach
description: Free health screening for children and families in surrounding communities. Partnered with local medical professionals.
